panels.description: The granddaughter looks from the broken drone component to older Alex at the boathouse. Leave upper lake space for her question.
Older Alex looks across Lake Keel, the first grey light touching the water and terraces. Leave upper sky clear for his answer.
Close on older Alex's face, carrying memory and restraint rather than a smile. Keep the lake softly out of focus and leave upper space for the unfinished line.
Lake Keel under first grey light, with the boathouse, distant terraces and empty water. No characters required; leave the sky open for the final line.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: When you don’t have anything, some people take the easy way out.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: It wasn’t always easy for me, either...
